ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed NetSupport RAT Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "client32.exe" (NetSupport RAT) via Imphash, Product and OriginalFileName strings

sequences.query: (process_product = RGX(".*NetSupport\\ Remote\\ Control.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*client32\\\.exe.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=A9D50692E95B79723F3E76FCF70D023E.*")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\client32\\\.exe$"))
